text: 本手册适用于 **FutureUI Studio 0.1.3 / Windows x64**。从未接触过 YAML 也可以按顺序完成。先在本地工程练习，再把确认过的配置交给服务器。

This guide covers **FutureUI Studio 0.1.3 for Windows x64**. You can follow it without previous YAML experience. Practice in a local project first, then deliver the reviewed configuration to your server.

items: 创建工程
编辑菜单
预览与回退
导出配置
服务器验证
Create project
Edit menus
Preview / restore
Export
Verify in game

rows: 运行安装版或便携版；无需为了使用编辑器单独安装 Node.js。
Runs the installer or portable build. You do not need to install Node.js just to use the editor.
保存菜单、模板、语言和资源。首次启动可自动创建示例工程。
Stores menus, templates, translations and assets. The first launch can create an example project.
FutureUI 游戏服务器（发布时）
实际运行菜单、经济交易、PAPI 与第三方插件功能。
Runs menus, real purchases, PAPI placeholders and third-party integrations.
只有使用 Agent 时才需要 Base URL、API Key 和模型 ID。
Base URL, API key and model ID are only needed for Agent features.

items: 第一次使用：先阅读安装、工程和界面总览，再完成“第一个菜单”。
First time: read installation, projects and the workspace tour; then complete the first-menu exercise.
已经有配置：阅读批量导入、冲突处理与快捷导出。
Already have configurations? Start with batch import, conflict handling and quick export.
想让 AI 帮忙：完成模型连接与 Skill 设置，再练习待审方案流程。
Want AI assistance? Configure a model and Skills, then learn the proposal-review workflow.
修改失误：打开“操作与回退”；先看差异，再选择恢复节点。
Made a mistake? Open 操作与回退 (Operations and restore), inspect the diff, then select a restore point.

title: 先记住这件事
Remember this first
text: **编辑、保存、导出、服务器重载是不同操作。** 本地画布不是 Minecraft 客户端；画布能显示不等于服务器业务已验证。
**Editing, saving, exporting and reloading a server are different operations.** The local canvas is not a Minecraft client. A correct preview does not prove that server-side business logic works.

items: 打开本项目 GitHub Releases，选择与本手册对应的 **v0.1.3**。下载 `FutureUI-Studio-Setup-0.1.3.exe`。
Open this project's GitHub Releases and select **v0.1.3**. Download `FutureUI-Studio-Setup-0.1.3.exe`.
双击安装包，按安装向导选择目录并完成安装。通过桌面或开始菜单中的 FutureUI Studio 启动。
Run the installer, choose an installation directory and complete the wizard. Launch FutureUI Studio from the desktop or Start menu shortcut.
首次进入时等待示例工程载入。左侧应出现菜单文件，中间应出现画布，底部会显示保存状态。
Wait for the example project to load. You should see menu files on the left, a canvas in the center and a save status at the bottom.
首次启动默认跟随系统：中文系统使用简体中文，其他系统使用英文。点击顶部语言图标，可选择“跟随系统 / 简体中文 / English”；手动选择会记住，切换不丢失未保存的编辑。

The interface follows the system on first launch: Chinese systems use Simplified Chinese; others use English. Use the top language icon to choose Follow system, 简体中文 or English. Manual choices are remembered, and switching preserves unsaved edits.
如果暂时不需要 AI，可以直接开始编辑；不必填写 API Key。
You can edit without AI. An API key is not required to use the editor.
建议通过“文件 > 新建工作工程”创建练习副本，不要直接把服务器生产目录作为第一次练习的位置。
Use 文件 > 新建工作工程 (File > New working project) for practice. Avoid using your live server directory for your first exercise.

rows: 日常使用。支持发现新版提醒、手动下载、安装后自动启动。
Daily use. Supports update notifications, manual downloads and relaunch after installation.
临时使用或移动使用。要使用应用内安装更新，需先安装一次 Setup。
Temporary or portable use. Install Setup once to enable in-app installation of updates.
更新服务使用；普通用户无需单独打开或运行。
Used by the updater. Users do not open or run these files themselves.

title: 安装成功的标志
Success checkpoint
text: 窗口标题为 FutureUI Studio，左上角显示项目名。通过“帮助 > 关于 FutureUI Studio”可以查看编辑器版本。底部的“FutureUI 1.0.0”是配置能力基线，不是 Studio 应用版本。

The window is titled FutureUI Studio and shows a project name. Use 帮助 > 关于 FutureUI Studio (Help > About) to inspect the application version. The bottom label “FutureUI 1.0.0” describes the configuration capability baseline, not the Studio application version.
发布页：[FutureUI Studio Releases](https://github.com/Ti-Avanti/FutureUI-Studio/releases)
Release page: [FutureUI Studio Releases](https://github.com/Ti-Avanti/FutureUI-Studio/releases)

title: 新建、打开与文件目录
Create, open and organize a project

items: 新建：点击“文件 > 新建工作工程”，选择一个父目录。软件会在其中创建 `FutureUI-工作工程` 并复制示例配置；如果同名目录已存在，换一个父目录。

Create: choose 文件 > 新建工作工程 (File > New working project), then choose a parent folder. Studio creates `FutureUI-工作工程` there and copies the examples. If that folder already exists, choose another parent.
打开：按 `Ctrl+O`，选择包含 `menus` 子目录的配置根目录。不要只选中某个 YAML 文件，也不要只选 `menus` 内部的子目录。
Open: press `Ctrl+O` and select the configuration root containing a `menus` directory. Do not select a single YAML file or a subfolder inside `menus`.
也可以打开具有 `src/main/resources/menus` 的插件源码目录，编辑器会识别配置资源目录。
You may also open a plugin source folder containing `src/main/resources/menus`; Studio recognizes the resource directory.
切换工程或重新读取磁盘前，先保存想保留的修改。遇到放弃修改提示时，确认自己选对了操作。
Save changes you want to keep before switching projects or rereading disk files. Read the discard-changes prompt before accepting it.

rows: 被多个菜单引用的共享组件。
商品、可复用流程、规则和 HUD 配置。
Products, reusable flows, rules and HUD configuration.
图片注册、主题、图片文件与着色器等资源。
Image definitions, themes, image files and shaders.
The main configuration in the project.
本地保存副本和保存节点；不要当作服务器菜单文件。
Local backup revisions and saved restore points, not server menu files.

title: 找不到文件？
Cannot find a file?
text: 左侧默认只显示菜单。切换“模板”或“全部文件”，再用搜索框输入文件名或路径。文件路径与菜单 `id` 不是同一个概念。
The left panel initially filters menus. Switch to 模板 (Templates) or 全部文件 (All files), then search by filename or path. A file path and a menu's `id` are not the same thing.

title: 认识编辑器的六个区域
Find your way around the workspace

caption: 实际界面：教程工程。PDF 可以放大查看，截图中的菜单是本书的练习示例。
Actual workspace with the tutorial project. Zoom the PDF to inspect details; the menu shown is the exercise used in this guide.

rows: 在设计、交互、动效、数据与语言、资源、发布之间切换。
Switch between design, interaction, motion, data/languages, assets and publishing.
搜索和打开 YAML；一个工程可同时打开多个文件标签。
Search and open YAML files; keep several file tabs open.
选中组件；拖动图层调整同文件内的顺序。
Select components and drag layers to reorder them within the same file.
画布、YAML 源码或两者并排；预览悬停与交互。
Use canvas, YAML or split view; inspect hover states and simulate interactions.
修改选中组件的尺寸、间距、皮肤、文案等。
Edit size, spacing, skin, text and other properties of the selected component.
资源库、时间轴、问题、历史记录。

title: 布局被拖乱时
If panels become misplaced
text: 打开“窗口 > 重置工作区布局”。需要更大画布时，在非输入状态按 `F`；再次按 `F` 还原。Agent 入口在顶部，也可按 `Ctrl+J`。
Choose 窗口 > 重置工作区布局 (Window > Reset workspace layout). Press `F` outside text fields to focus the canvas; press it again to restore. Open Agent from the top bar or with `Ctrl+J`.

title: 准备一个可运行的菜单文件
Prepare a usable first menu

text: 下载[教程示例 ZIP](https://github.com/Ti-Avanti/FutureUI-Studio/releases/download/v0.1.3/FutureUI-Studio-Tutorial-Examples.zip) 并解压。本页文件位于 `01-first-menu/menus/tutorial/hello.yml`。也可以用 UTF-8 无 BOM 手动保存下面的完整内容。不要在文件外再包一层 `menus:`。

Download and extract the [tutorial examples ZIP](https://github.com/Ti-Avanti/FutureUI-Studio/releases/download/v0.1.3/FutureUI-Studio-Tutorial-Examples.zip). This file is `01-first-menu/menus/tutorial/hello.yml`. Alternatively, save the complete content below as UTF-8 without BOM. Do not wrap it in an extra `menus:` key.

title: 这个例子做什么
What this example does
text: 显示标题、玩家名和一个消息按钮。它使用示例工程的 `compact` 主题，不进行交易。目录里的 `02-merge-update` 是之后的合并练习补丁，不要作为完整页面替换本文件。

It displays a heading, a player name and a message button using the example project's `compact` theme. It performs no transaction. `02-merge-update` is a merge patch for a later exercise; do not replace this complete page with that patch.

title: 把第一个菜单导入工程
Import the first menu into your project

items: 先打开一个工作工程。按 `Ctrl+Shift+I`，或点击顶部“配置导入与导出”图标。
Open a working project. Press `Ctrl+Shift+I`, or click the top-bar 配置导入与导出 (Configuration import/export) icon.
选择“导入与合并 > 选择目录”，定位到解压后的 `01-first-menu`。也可以选择单个 `hello.yml`。
Choose 导入与合并 > 选择目录 (Import and merge > Choose directory), then select the extracted `01-first-menu` folder. You can also choose `hello.yml` individually.
在文件列表里确认勾选。目标路径应是 `menus/tutorial/hello.yml`；如果路径没有被自动识别，手动改成这个值。
Ensure the file is checked. Its target should be `menus/tutorial/hello.yml`; correct the target field manually if it was not detected.
右侧应显示“当前不存在”和导入内容。点击“应用导入”；此时只修改了编辑器中的工程。
The diff should show 当前不存在 (Does not currently exist) and the incoming content. Click 应用导入 (Apply import). This changes the editor project, not the files on disk yet.
按 `Ctrl+S` 保存。在项目搜索框输入 `tutorial/hello`，点击该文件。
Press `Ctrl+S` to save. Search for `tutorial/hello` in the Project panel and open it.
检查中间显示 My first menu、Hello 和 Say hello。底部应显示“所有修改已保存”。
Confirm the canvas shows My first menu, Hello and Say hello. The status bar should read 所有修改已保存 (All changes saved).

caption: 导入入口。首次练习只选择 01-first-menu，其他示例留到后续章节。
Import entry point. For this exercise select only 01-first-menu; use the other samples in later chapters.

title: 新增菜单的实用方式
Practical ways to add a menu
text: 0.1.3 可通过配置导入或 Agent 方案创建新文件。“新建工作工程”创建的是整个工程，不是单个菜单。
In 0.1.3, create new files through configuration import or an Agent proposal. 新建工作工程 creates a whole project, not a single menu.

title: 选中组件并修改按钮
Select a component and change a button

items: 打开 `tutorial/hello`，在左下图层中点击 `hello_button`。也可以在选择工具下直接点击画布按钮。
Open `tutorial/hello`, then click `hello_button` in Layers. You can also click the canvas button while using the selection tool.
右侧属性顶部应显示 `hello_button`。如果仍显示“画布设置”，说明尚未选中具体组件。
The Inspector heading should show `hello_button`. If it still shows 画布设置 (Canvas settings), you have not selected a component.
在“文字内容”里输入新的按钮名称。点击输入框外使文字提交；尺寸等属性按字段操作提交。
Enter new text under 文字内容 (Text content). Click outside the text box to commit it; other properties commit through their respective controls.
把高度改成 `36`，皮肤保持 `button`。观察画布与 YAML 同步变化。
Change height to `36`, keeping the `button` skin. Observe the matching changes in the canvas and YAML.
试一次 `Ctrl+Z` 或顶部撤销按钮，再重做。确认后按 `Ctrl+S`。
Try `Ctrl+Z` or the top Undo button, then redo. Press `Ctrl+S` when satisfied.
需要多个相似按钮：在非文本输入状态按 `Ctrl+D` 复制选中组件；删除选中组件使用 `Delete`。
For similar buttons, press `Ctrl+D` outside a text input to duplicate the selection. Use `Delete` to remove the selected component.

caption: 组件属性入口；先确认选中对象，再修改尺寸和文字。
Component properties. Confirm the selected object before changing size or text.

title: 操作小提示
Editing tip
text: 拖动画布本身用于平移视图，不是任意移动控件位置。组件排布由 row、column、grid 等容器以及宽高、间距决定。
Dragging the canvas pans the view; it does not freely reposition controls. Containers such as row, column and grid, together with size and spacing, determine layout.

title: 布局、模板与像素尺寸
Work with layout, templates and pixel sizes

rows: 横排 / 纵排 / 网格。先决定容器，再放组件。
Horizontal, vertical and grid containers. Decide the structure before adding components.
游戏 GUI 像素单位，不是显示器物理像素；放大预览不会改变配置宽高。
Game GUI pixel units, not monitor pixels. Preview zoom does not change configuration dimensions.
内边距 / 子项间距。可以从 9、18、27 开始建立统一节奏。
Inside padding and spacing between children. Values such as 9, 18 and 27 make a consistent starting grid.
水平 / 垂直对齐；文字本身另有 text-align。
Horizontal and vertical alignment. Text alignment is separately controlled by text-align.
组件的外观，如 panel、button、selected、readout。可用项取决于工程主题。
Appearance such as panel, button, selected or readout. Available skins depend on the project's theme.
共享组件来源。修改模板文件会影响引用它的页面。
The shared component source. Editing the template affects pages that reference it.

items: 先选中容器，再用工具栏“添加文字 / 添加图片 / 添加按钮”。新增组件会加入选中容器；未选容器时通常加入当前页面根组件列表。
Select a container, then use 添加文字 / 添加图片 / 添加按钮 (Add text/image/button). New components go into the selected container, or usually into the page's root component list if no container is selected.
要调整顺序，拖动同一个文件里的图层。跨文件移动不会直接执行；请复制配置并检查引用。
Drag layers within the same file to change order. Direct cross-file moves are blocked; copy the configuration and check references instead.
选择模板实例时，留意右侧“来源文件”。在源码里确认自己修改的是共享模板还是当前实例。
For a template instance, check 来源文件 (Source file). Confirm in YAML whether you are editing the shared template or the current instance.
使用“适合”查看整体，再用 200% 或更高缩放检查像素边缘和文字。0.1.3 会在缩小时保留完整中文字形，避免笔画被取整抹去；高倍缩放仍保持像素风格。

Use Fit for the overall layout, then 200% or higher to inspect pixels and text. Version 0.1.3 retains complete Chinese glyphs at smaller scales instead of rounding strokes away; larger zoom levels keep the pixel style.

title: 布局改动后的检查
After a layout change
text: 检查长文字、按钮悬停和窄窗口状态。文本、字体和着色器最终效果以真实客户端为准；不要靠超大固定宽高掩盖溢出。
Check long text, hover states and smaller windows. The real client is authoritative for text, fonts and shaders; avoid masking overflow with oversized fixed dimensions.
